a:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production animation sprite atlas, Human Last Rampart K-119.
Reference image is K-110 worker A's push strip: identity/style reference ONLY. Create NEW WALK, STAIR, TEND, CARRY poses of this same stocky middle-aged man: receding brown hair with grey temples, dark mustache, cream sleeveless shirt, rust brown leather apron, dark trousers, big brown boots. Large readable head, small blue eyes with white glint, mouth, thick dark outline, chunky hard pixel clusters, ~3 shades per material, upper left light. Absolutely no bloom/gradients/glow/soft painterly texture.
OUTPUT: transparent PNG atlas, 1536 wide x 3072 high. EXACTLY 8 equal columns and 12 equal rows, thus tiles 192x256. Each figure approximately 146 pixels tall (73 logical pixels rendered 2x), centered at local x96, foot contact baseline local y240. Keep head/body size IDENTICAL across all tiles. Plenty transparent margin around every tile. No grid, labels, letters, scenery, floor, cast ground shadows or stair objects.
Every row is a separate motion, sequential poses left to right:
row1 WALK FRONT 8 frames; row2 WALK BACK 8; row3 WALK RIGHT PROFILE 8. Walk is free relaxed alternating arm swing, contact/down/passing/up then opposite foot, NOT pushing arms.
row4 CLIMB UP RIGHT PROFILE 6 frames in columns1-6, columns7-8 empty. Knee lifts high, forward lean, planted supporting foot at baseline, opposite raised foot.
row5 CLIMB UP BACK 6 frames columns1-6, last2 empty.
row6 CLIMB DOWN RIGHT PROFILE 6 frames columns1-6, last2 empty. Distinct descent: cautious backward torso lean, forward reaching lower boot, bend supporting knee.
row7 CLIMB DOWN BACK 6 frames columns1-6, last2 empty.
row8 TEND FRONT 6 frames columns1-6, last2 empty. Lift small iron oil can from waist to chest, tilt spout out to pour, return. Can always attached to hand, no particles.
row9 TEND RIGHT PROFILE 6 frames columns1-6, last2 empty. Same oil can lift/tilt/return.
row10 CARRY WALK FRONT 8 frames. Same small iron oil can held by handle near hip, feet walking, free arm swings.
row11 CARRY WALK BACK 8 frames.
row12 CARRY WALK RIGHT PROFILE 8 frames.
All 96 occupied frames must be distinct articulated animation poses. Keep apron, hair, skin, boots coherent. Same compact pixel density as reference. Left versions will be mirrored programmatically; avoid asymmetric logos. Feet planted in each frame; no vertical root motion (game moves along stairs).
